assumptions.decision: Default inference wall budget is 1800 seconds; all six held-out/library splits precede any train loading. Full train admission uses measured CPU throughput with a 1.5x safety factor. No sampled train result is reported as full train.

NPZ files use {train,val,test,LIB}/{TSP,CVRP}.npz under nss_predictions. Fields indices, logits, costs, winner, pool, pool_ids and nodes follow the main parser contract. Native winner means the stored raw_label.pkl ind; pred is the frozen NSS greedy prediction. Both raw FP64 and historical FP32 argmins are separate fields.

nodes/node_sizes count actual unpadded model-input nodes, including the CVRP depot. customer_sizes excludes that depot. Historical FP32-label Top1/Top3 use the original collator and torch.topk on logits, not native-winner labels. Historical agreement is necessary, not a complete correctness proof.

The optional 2000-of-10000 training sample uses ten equal-width strata over actual size (CVRP customer count excludes its depot), proportional largest-remainder quotas with bin-id tie breaking, and NumPy PCG64 seed 2024 to sample without replacement within strata. Original selected indices are sorted before original batch-8 inference. Only training node sizes and indices determine selection, never costs, winners, logits, or held-out performance.

Only after all six held-out splits complete and full train is skipped, append optional train_sample/{TSP,CVRP}.npz and train_sample/sampling_summary.json under nss_predictions. Preserve original source indices. Sample outputs are never placed under train/ or labeled full-train complete; all sampling and inference must fit the original 1800-second overall budget.

contract.costs: raw_label.pkl Python binary64 costs, never FP32-recast
contract.winner: native stored raw_label.pkl ind; not recomputed from rounded costs
contract.nodes: actual unpadded input node count; includes CVRP depot
contract.indices: zero-based indices in original dataset.pkl order
contract.historical_metrics: torch.topk(logits) vs original collator FP32 cost argmin

historical_check.metric_definition: original torch.topk(logits) vs original collator FP32 cost argmin
explanation: Native stored winners and raw FP64 argmins are not used for this historical check.
Any native-vs-FP32 label disagreement is measured separately; rounding can change exact tie winners.
The exporter is CPU-only; the historical evaluator defaults to cuda:0 with CPU fallback.
The historical JSON has no checkpoint/data hashes or execution-device record, so it cannot prove artifact identity.
No parameters, preprocessing, batch composition, or predictions are tuned to match the historical values.

train_decision.reason: measured full-train estimate exceeds remaining wall budget

TSP.allocation: proportional largest remainder; ties by ascending bin id
TSP.output_order: ascending original dataset index; original NSS batch size 8

CVRP.allocation: proportional largest remainder; ties by ascending bin id
CVRP.output_order: ascending original dataset index; original NSS batch size 8

exporter_note: Training-sample support was added after the held-out process exited; held-out NPZ files are unchanged.
